mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing buprenorphine plasma concentrations and increasing risk of withdrawal symptoms or reduced analgesia/opioid substitution efficacy.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor for reduced buprenorphine efficacy; consider alternative antidepressant with minimal enzyme induction; if coadministration necessary, may require buprenorphine dose adjustment and close clinical monitoring.
